notes.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong gets a release date&theme song!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Ever since we released the demo, we've been hard at work, tweaking every single detail of the game just to make it perfect when it's on your hands. And good news, the end is finally near! Very soon, you will be able to start your journey to the Thousand Peaks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31699457/56b948419dc2f24aa22e2c7de9c6abfdd1188d35.gif

To learn a little bit more about our main protagonists, theme song, and of course, the release date...

👉Watch the Release Date Trailer Now👈

"We will find each other, no matter how long it takes."

Exiled by his people, Jun ventures out in search of starsongs to redeem himself. But progress is slow until he saves Eda, a witch who can pick up on the sound of asteroids. However, what appears to be a blessed encounter, will end up becoming a lifelong burden...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31699457/1854ebfa13b517a0ea726d1cc87016daac398140.gif

Mark your dates and wishlist+follow on Steam, because Echo of Starsong is scheduled to be released on Steam on 9/1/2021! 

🔔 We’ve received lots of useful feedback from OPUS: Echo of Starsong demo. Thank you all! 

To turn these feedback into iteration and polish the game to perfection, we’ll deactivate the demo in 18 hrs. And we hope to bring the best experience when the game launch: )

notes.title: Rocket of Whispers new version available!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31699457/201e11c0639626e36c23fc843b1fae231669d042.jpg

To celebrate Summer Sale, we are bringing you the latest and greatest update of the game!

We are SIGONO, the indie game studio that brought you OPUS: The Day We Found Earth. We’d like to let you know that our new award-winning title, OPUS: Rocket of Whispers, has just launched a new release.

We’ve added so many new things and improvements over the last few months it’s going to blow your minds! 

➤ Brand new side quests 
The players who finished the main story will be able to further explore the world and uncover the mystery on the plague.

➤ Director’s Commentary
We have recorded 16 voice tracks talking about the development process of the game, and how we eventually made OPUS the game.

Uncover the mystery now!
